limitations: The bare bullet 'Nov. 1' on this page does not itself carry a year suffix. The year is established by two directly-fetched, explicitly-dated anchors from the same page cluster: (1) this same page's Early Decision FAQ states 'The FAFSA will be available on Oct.1, 2026' as part of the same financial-aid answer that references the Nov. 15 ED financial-aid deadline; (2) the companion admissions.umich.edu Application Changes page explicitly states the Regular Decision deadline as 'Feb. 1, 2027' and frames the whole cycle as 'entry in fall 2027.' Nov. 1 (ED) falls chronologically between these two directly-dated anchors within the same named admissions cycle, so 2026-11-01 is recorded as a documented inference, not an invented date -- this differs from a case with no year evidence anywhere (which would instead be recurring_annual_undated).
researcher_notes: Early Decision (ED) is BINDING -- see the mandatory companion requirement record REQ-2026-08-21-MIC0036 in the companion requirements file for the exact binding-commitment language (Early Decision Agreement signed by applicant, parent/guardian, and counselor; immediate withdrawal from all other colleges upon admission). U-M added ED only recently (first offered for the prior, fall-2026-entry cycle); it continues into this fall-2027-entry cycle per this page. Decision release stated as 'By Dec. 24' on this page (also phrased more loosely as 'end of December' on the general requirements-deadlines page) -- not recorded as its own deadline row, consistent with this batch's precedent of not recording decision-RELEASE dates (a university-to-student notification) as student-facing deadlines; only student-facing commitment/submission dates are recorded as rows.

limitations: Same year-inference chain as the Early Decision deadline record (DL-2026-08-21-MIC0001) -- see that record's limitations field for the full anchor chain.
researcher_notes: Early Action (EA) is NONBINDING and, per this page's own text, NON-RESTRICTIVE: 'Early Action is nonbinding, meaning admitted students can consider all of their options, including decisions from other colleges/universities and financial aid packages, before making a decision.' Per this batch's brief, no separate binding/exclusivity companion requirement record was created for EA, since it carries no binding or exclusivity constraint -- this quote is recorded here instead, in this deadline record's own notes, to preserve the fact without an unnecessary companion record. Decision release stated as 'By Jan. 29' -- not recorded as its own row (decision-release dates are not recorded as deadlines in this batch, only student-facing submission/commitment dates).

This is the most directly-dated deadline in this batch: the companion Application Changes page states this exact date with its year explicitly attached, verbatim: 'Early Decision or Early Action applicants who have been postponed or Regular Decision applicants may self-report ACT/SAT scores prior to the Feb. 1, 2027 Regular Decision deadline.' Regular Decision (RD) is nonbinding. Two other application deadlines share this same Feb. 1 date but are for different terms, not recorded as separate rows to avoid duplicating an identical date under a near-identical label: the general requirements-deadlines calendar also lists Feb. 1 as the 'Summer Half Term Application Deadline,' and the international-applicants requirements page separately lists 'Spring term-Feb. 1.' Deadline to self-report SAT/ACT scores for RD consideration is also Feb. 1 (same date as the application deadline itself, not a separate later window) -- not recorded as its own row. Decision release stated as 'By April 2' -- not recorded as its own row per this batch's decision-release-dates-excluded precedent.

limitations: Independently corroborated (same date, same label) on finaid.umich.edu/apply-aid/new-undergraduates/deadlines, a third distinct official source.
researcher_notes: Requires both the FAFSA and the CSS Profile. applies_to set to 'domestic' rather than 'both' per this batch's explicit instruction not to record FAFSA-gated financial-aid deadlines as applying to international applicants: FAFSA is a U.S. federal-aid form that is domestic-only by definition, and U-M has separately confirmed (see REQ-2026-08-21-MIC0033 in the companion requirements file) that international students on temporary visas are not eligible for need-based financial aid at all, regardless of CSS Profile submission. Do not record this as an international deadline even though CSS Profile alone is technically usable by international families at some other institutions.

limitations: A SUGGESTED (not required) filing date -- filing by this date gets a preliminary aid package sooner, per finaid.umich.edu's own wording ('Applicants who file their financial aid application by the Suggested Filing Date of Dec. 15, and are admitted, will receive a preliminary financial aid package sooner'). The REQUIRED deadline for EA/RD applicants is March 1 -- see DL-2026-08-21-MIC0006.
researcher_notes: Same domestic-only reasoning as DL-2026-08-21-MIC0004 (FAFSA-gated). Independently corroborated on finaid.umich.edu/apply-aid/new-undergraduates/deadlines.

finaid.umich.edu's own dedicated deadlines page (finaid.umich.edu/apply-aid/new-undergraduates/deadlines) independently corroborates this exact date and adds process detail not on the admissions site: 'If your FAFSA is rejected, you may miss the March 1 deadline. The most common reason is missing required signatures ... We may request other documents to complete the review of your application. Those must also reach us by March 1 to consider you for aid.' U-M does not participate in the College Board IDOC service (per the same finaid page) -- a documented negative fact worth preserving for advisor accuracy (a student should not be told to use IDOC for U-M).

limitations: This is a distinct, minor entry point (Winter Term, i.e. starting January) alongside the primary Fall-term ED/EA/RD tracks that are the focus of this batch. cycle_year=2027 here represents the calendar year in which Winter Term instruction begins (January 2027), applying this batch's entry-year convention to a non-fall term by analogy rather than by an explicit source statement -- confidence set to medium to reflect that extension.
researcher_notes: U-M's international-applicants requirements-deadlines page separately confirms international students may find it logistically difficult to apply for Winter Term at all, because many countries' fall terms do not end until January or February: 'Because ... U-M's winter term starts at the beginning of January and because the fall term in many countries does not end until late January or February, it may not be possible to apply for U-M's winter term.' IMPORTANT -- do not confuse this Oct. 1 ADMISSION application deadline for Winter Term with a DIFFERENT Nov. 15 FINANCIAL AID deadline that also applies specifically to Winter Term entrants (per finaid.umich.edu/apply-aid/new-undergraduates/deadlines: 'Entering Winter Term ... Nov. 15 - Deadline ... complete and submit a current year FAFSA and CSS Profile at the time you apply for admission') -- that Winter-Term financial aid Nov. 15 date is a separate fact from the Fall-term Early Decision financial aid Nov. 15 deadline (DL-2026-08-21-MIC0004); neither is recorded as its own additional row here to keep this batch focused on the primary Fall-entry cycle, but the distinction is flagged here so the two same-numbered dates are not conflated downstream.

deadline_text_verbatim: Dec. 1 - Application Deadline for School of Music, Theatre & Dance Students Only
limitations: General web search surfaced third-party phrasing attributing this deadline to 'Fall 2027' explicitly, but this researcher's own DIRECT fetch of SMTD's own application page (smtd.umich.edu/admissions/undergraduate/apply-undergrad/) showed only 'Submit the Common Application on or before December 1' with no year stated. Per this batch's evidence discipline (search discovers, fetch verifies -- a search snippet never becomes a record), the year is deliberately NOT carried onto this record despite it being highly plausible from context (it would chronologically fit between the 2026-10-01 and 2027-02-01 anchors used elsewhere in this batch); recorded as recurring_annual_undated rather than dated_specific.
researcher_notes: Companion admissions.umich.edu page frames this as: 'Most first-year admitting schools and colleges at U-M will participate in the three decision plans, with School of Music, Theatre & Dance (SMTD) programs only available through Regular Decision with a unique Dec. 1 deadline' -- i.e., SMTD does not offer separate ED/EA rounds; this single Dec. 1 date is its whole first-year application window, categorized under the Regular-Decision pathway but earlier than the general Feb. 1 RD date. Both the $75 Common Application and a separate $45 SMTD 'Artistic Profile' (with audition/portfolio/interview materials) are due by this same date -- see REQ-2026-08-21-MIC0042 in the companion requirements file.
